details.detail: Overall massing: the 2-4-2 blocks, reclined backs, navy flaps, rounded aisle shrouds, consoles and leg rests read as the ZIM PY seat in p13a, q14 and p14c. The r2 'tombstone' shell tops are gone: the shell now ends in an arch at about headrest height (p15back, st/p3). The console at 0.12 m sits better against the cushion (st/p3 console to cushion about 0.28, py_37301 about 0.3).

Rear shell and screen: the arch reads right and the screen now sits framed in the shell with its housing about 2.5 cm proud, close to san_05 and san_13. New artefact: the speckled headrest wing pads poke out above and outside the arch at both top corners. They show from behind as grey-white lumps on the shell shoulders (p15back, most rows; p2). The cause: wing top at y 0.92, x 0.195 +- 0.05, rotated 18 deg, while the shell half-width is only 0.215 at 0.905 and 0.165 at 0.925. In san_05 and alv_03 nothing of the headrest shows past the shell rim from behind.

Headrest, flap and gooseneck: the flap colour now matches (p13a flap (49,56,88) against py_37302 (47,61,108)). The goosenecks (thick black flexible arm, brushed head about 38 x 110 mm) match py_37305 closely. The wing pads also match py_37305 (white flakes on navy-grey, mean (94,96,102) against (85,87,103)). The flakes are denser and bigger than the real sparse petals, though, so at distance the wings read as granite (q14, p14c). The wings are still separate upright sausages with a crease against the back. In py_37305 and alv_04 they are the rounded ends of one continuous headrest pad that the flap drapes over.

Back and cushion fabric: the tone and contrast are now in range (p13a back p10/p90 107/183 against py_37301 118/208). The colour is a little neutral against ANA's blue cast but fine against the real web photos. The motif still differs: long bright horizontal streaks over soft dark low-frequency cloud blotches. The blotches are clearly visible close up (x2/p14c left edge, st/p5 cushions). The real weave is either a fine dash weave with no blotches (py_37305, san_02) or alv's leafy mottle.

Centre console: the width is better, the light-grey two-cup tray at the nose matches alv_04 and san_06, and the sockets and red tab are right. The cubbies are still solid plates under a black slot (st/p5), not open U-lipped trays with a visible inner lip. The blue marks are 3-segment cylinders, so they render as equilateral 'play' arrows pointing sideways. In alv_09 they are right-angled corner triangles filling the top-left corner (upper cubby) and the top-right corner (lower cubby).

Aisle and window shrouds: the side view (p7) still matches py_37303. The arm caps render near-black (x2/p14c about (35,36,40)). In py_37301 and py_37302 the aisle arm cap is a mid slate-grey, only slightly darker than the shroud.

Seat-back lower half: the footrest is now single, with two ribbed pads, silver end caps and a hub, as in alv_06. It hangs on two angled centre struts. The real one has one silver arm, off-centre, down to the floor. The literature pocket is unchanged: a proud hood with a trapezoid black mesh basket (st/p2, p6). Real (alv_05): a rigid grey upper tray, then below it a flat stitched leatherette panel with a narrow horizontal mesh window, nearly flush.

Bottle bin: it is now floor-standing and the right width, with a placard. From above (p6) its top reads as one black slab, because the two 'hole' cells (0.062 each) cover almost the whole 0.145 x 0.08 top. The real cells (alv_05, alv_07) are light grey/silver cups with thin walls, with light inside. Real: light-grey bin on a darker pedestal carrying the placard.

issues.detail: Headrest wings poke through the shell arch
issues.problem: From behind, the speckled wing pads show above and outside the rounded shell top at both corners of every seat (p15back, st/p2). The wing top is at 0.92, x 0.195 +- 0.05, where the shell is only 0.43 wide at 0.905 and 0.33 at 0.925.
issues.fix: 09b_py.js l.32-33: widen the top of ds: [0.88,0.075,0.50],[0.905,0.066,0.47],[0.925,0.05,0.41],[0.935,0.03,0.32]. Alternatively lower the wing pads (l.41) so the last two sections are at 0.89/0.905 and pull the wing x from 0.195 to 0.185. Re-check that nothing speckled shows from the p15back camera.

issues.problem: The back and cushion fabric still has soft dark cloud blotches under the dash streaks (x2/p14c, st/p5). Neither photo set shows them.
issues.evidence: w3r/x2/p14c.png left, st/p5 cushions vs ref/ana/py_37305, ref/web/py/san_02
issues.fix: 03_tex.js LAYER_PARAMS (shared, one line): cut the low-frequency amplitude of LAYER.pyFleck to about 0, or high-pass the py_back swatch harder in make_swatches.py (a larger blur radius for the subtracted mean).

issues.problem: It is still a 5 cm proud hood over a trapezoid mesh basket. Real: a rigid upper tray plus a flat stitched leatherette panel with a narrow mesh window.
issues.fix: l.72-77: replace the hood, ribs and loft with a panel gRBox(0.36,0.14,0.018,0.012,1) at on(0.14,0.012) in pyShell, a mesh window gBox(0.30,0.05,0.002) at on(0.13,0.022) in the grille material, and a rigid tray lip gRBox(0.40,0.03,0.05,0.012,1) at on(0.235,0.025) in pyShell.

issues.problem: gCyl(...,3) makes equilateral arrows pointing sideways. The real marks are right-angled corner triangles.
issues.fix: l.147: build a right triangle (for example a 4-segment cylinder rotated 45 deg and clipped, or two gQuad halves). Legs about 0.03 x 0.03, hypotenuse toward the pocket centre, filling the top-left corner of the upper cubby and the top-right corner of the lower one (the code comment says bottom-right; alv_09 shows top-right).

issues.problem: pyArmPad #4a4c50 renders almost black on the aisle and window shroud caps. In the photos they are mid slate-grey.
issues.fix: SEATMAT pyArmPad (shared, one line): #4a4c50 -> about #5e636c. Or give the shroud caps their own lighter material and keep the console lid dark (san_06).

issues.detail: Bottle-bin cells read as a black slab
issues.problem: The two hole-coloured cells cover nearly all of the bin top.
issues.fix: l.174: make the cells pyBin-coloured recessed cups. Shrink them to 0.058 with a 0.01 wall, use a mid-grey (#8a8e92) for the inner floor and not SEATMAT.hole, and make the pedestal below y 0.30 pyArm.

issues.detail: Wing flakes too dense and large
issues.problem: The py_confetti tile gives dense large chips, so the wings read as granite at distance. py_37305 has sparse, small petal flakes.
issues.fix: Thin the flake density about 50 % in the py_confetti swatch or LAYER.pyConfetti. Keep the mean colour.

issues.problem: There are two symmetric angled centre struts. The real footrest has one silver arm off-centre down to the floor (alv_05, alv_06).
issues.fix: l.99: keep only the s=+1 strut, moved to x0+0.05. Optionally add a floor foot.

verifiedFixes.blue triangles: present, but the shape is wrong (sideways equilateral)
verifiedFixes.floor-standing silver bottle bin: yes, but the top reads black
verifiedFixes.fabric tile redrawn: partly: the contrast is fine, low-frequency blotches remain

questionsForUser: Fabric motif: ANA's official photos (py_37305) show a dash weave, while the 2026 Alviator photos (alv_04, alv_09) show a leafy mottle. Which should the SFO-NRT aircraft follow?
